_strategyNote: Creates a botcomponent row directly via Dataverse. Used by build-pipeline to create topic (componenttype=9), test (componenttype=19), or other component types that MCS can't seed via bot.configuration alone.
responseShape: 201 Created with Location header + botcomponentid in response body
lastVerifiedBy: Direct use in build-pipeline.stepComponents + build-pipeline has been tested against multiple live bots
knownQuirks: componenttype=9 for custom topics (NOT 1 which is Botskill — common confusion)
componenttype=19 for MakerEval test components (via this Dataverse path as fallback)
Duplicate schemaname returns 412 Precondition Failed (not 409 Conflict)
data column accepts JSON string; for GptComponent MCS UI doesn't render records created via raw POST — use LSP push or Island Gateway instead

errorCases.reason: Duplicate schemaname on same parent bot
